title: Analysis code for: Two-phase displacement of disulfidptosis-related transcriptional programs in Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy

creators.name: Gu, Yuhan
creators.affiliation: School of Ophthalmology and Optometry, Wenzhou Medical University

creators.name: Wang, Yudi
creators.affiliation: School of Ophthalmology and Optometry, Wenzhou Medical University

description: R and Python pipeline for a purely computational re-analysis of public human corneal endothelial transcriptomes (GSE142538, GSE112201, GSE74123): quality filtering, limma-voom differential expression, WGCNA co-expression modules, GO/GSEA enrichment, three-tier candidate intersection, stability selection, program-axis scoring, gene-pathway coupling, and the independent GSE74123 direction check. Includes all scripts, session information and a reproducibility README.
